name: Mortal Kombat 4 — Liu Kang Ending
notes: Primary Liu Kang ending material preserved by Mortal Kombat Warehouse, used as preservation/access infrastructure rather than canonical authority. The ending frames Liu Kang as having defended Earthrealm and Kitana credits Shinnok's destruction with saving both Earthrealm and Edenia. This supports an ending-specific individual-victor reading, but later Original-continuity biography evidence used by this project confirms only that Shinnok was defeated by Liu Kang's side, so no canon individual-victor Fact is promoted from this ending alone.
